findings.description: F002 validates that a reconstructed evidence path recomputes to the same path_key, but it does not explicitly reject or normalize a literal path_display that is actually under Path.home(). Such evidence could stamp a raw home path into historical canonical_repo data, and F003/F004 would then preserve or serialize it, violating the C1 privacy boundary.
findings.recommendation: Pin a C4 validation rule that compares evidence path_display against make_path_pair(reconstructed_path).path_display and only writes the scrubbed display; reject literal absolute paths under Path.home().

findings.description: F003 describes reconcile() as a pure function, but its steps also require registered-side keys to be computed via the F001 filesystem/git canonicalization. That creates an unresolved boundary: registered_active and registered_path_missing need canonical keys and path-existence facts, but the pure reconciliation input contract does not define where those facts come from.
findings.recommendation: Split a registry-to-canonical adapter from reconcile(), and define the exact registered row shape passed into the pure function, including canonical_repo_key, scrubbed display, path_exists, and any unresolved-path status.

findings.description: The plan requires a minimum recency and count threshold, but the default policy values, timestamp field, boundary inclusivity, and CLI default wiring are not pinned. The isolated p2a/p2-lock/main fixture can only deterministically produce exactly one candidate if these policy cells are fixed before implementation.
findings.recommendation: Define conservative default values for window_days and min_count, specify which ledger timestamp drives last_seen, and pin inclusive/exclusive threshold behavior for tests and CLI output.

findings.description: F002 says a temp-prefix path must never be written as a canonical recommendation source, but the deterministic C4 skip matrix does not explicitly include a reconstructed canonical path under /tmp, /private/tmp, or /var/folders, nor an evidence row that marks such a path durable_checkout=true.
findings.recommendation: Add a C4 matrix cell that reconstructs the canonical display, applies the same temp-prefix test as F001, and skips any evidence whose canonical path is temp-prefixed regardless of durable_checkout.

findings.description: F002 promises a command or script with --dry-run, but the operator-facing entrypoint, ledger path resolution, DONTPANIC_HOME override behavior, exit codes, and dry-run/report schema are not specified. That leaves the backfill journey hard to test and ambiguous for the operator running the one-time migration.
findings.recommendation: Name the entrypoint and pin its inputs, default ledger/evidence paths, home override behavior, exit-code contract, and machine-readable dry-run counts before implementation locks.
